name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.57.0 selectively adapts five Python stdlib-only evaluation-rigor, document-table synchronization, multi-turn query framing, and opt-in Stage-2 decision-API candidate reranking patterns from ai3inc/opentoolsearch (v0.2.1, commit 7da656d, Apache-2.0) — paired flat and stratified-macro bootstrap CIs plus deterministic 2-fold SHA-256 cross-fitting (scripts/eval_stats.py, evaluate_recall.py --bootstrap-ci), cross-split near-duplicate query leakage auditing and isolated Markdown layout-invariance probing (scripts/eval_recall_hygiene.py, evaluate_recall.py --check-split-leakage and --layout-invariance), fail-closed JSON-to-Markdown table synchronization (scripts/sync_result_tables.py), multi-turn query framing guidance in commands/vault-recall.md, and opt-in single-choice Stage-2 candidate reranking via TypeSafe Jev or BizRouter with optional z-score fusion and external_candidates sidecar output (scripts/rerank_candidates.py) — and removes the embedded webapp-principles skill and guide (now maintained separately in Technoetic/webapp6; Antigravity CLI skills 17 -> 16). Retained from v0.56.0: pre-registered evaluation plans with dual-verdict post-hoc amendments (scripts/verify_eval_plan.py), self-verifying install-state digests and host/OS coverage matrices (vault_install_state.py, vault_coverage_matrix.py), and silent no-op activation audits (scripts/eval_activation.py). Retained from v0.55.0: verification-date staleness warnings, alias-collision lint, URL-query egress guard, cloud-sync awareness and capability summaries. No new runtime dependencies; Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. The seven certificate-bound checker files remain byte-identical from v0.55.0 through v0.57.0; when upgrading from v0.54.1 or earlier where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
